reason: B proposes a single testable intervention in a qualifying equiatomic FeCoNiMnCu alloy and is directly supported by an earlier observation of roughly 40-fold coercivity enhancement after RTA with little loss of saturation magnetization. Its L1₀-like ordering mechanism overgeneralizes evidence from the separate Pt-rich alloy and needs tighter composition and falsification criteria, but it is substantially better grounded and more discriminating than A’s unsupported Mn-pinning proposal.
